mapper.sql: FROM doctor d INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.user_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id

d.id AS doctor_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, d.name, d.department_id, dep.name AS department, d.title, d.introduction, CASE u.status WHEN '正常' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN '禁用' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE u.status END AS status, d.status AS doctor_status, CASE d.status WHEN '待审核' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN '启用' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '停用' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE d.status END AS audit_status, u.create_time

WHERE 1 = 1
AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = '正常'
AND u.status = '禁用'
AND d.status = '待审核'
AND d.status = #{query.status}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS doctor_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, d.name, d.department_id, dep.name AS department, d.title, d.introduction, CASE u.status WHEN '正常' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN '禁用' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE u.status END AS account_status, d.status AS doctor_status, d.disable_reason, d.disable_time, d.disabled_by, disabled_admin.username AS disabled_by_name, u.create_time
LEFT JOIN sys_user disabled_admin ON disabled_admin.id = d.disabled_by WHERE d.id = #{doctorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log WHERE target_type = 'DOCTOR' AND target_id = #{doctorId}

SELECT l.id, l.operation_type, l.action, l.target, l.reason, l.result, l.operator_id, operator.username AS operator_name, l.create_time FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = l.operator_id WHERE l.target_type = 'DOCTOR' AND l.target_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor WHERE status = '待审核'

SELECT
WHERE d.status = '待审核' ORDER BY d.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT d.id AS doctor_id, d.user_id, d.name, d.status AS doctor_status FROM doctor d WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor SET status = #{doctorStatus}, disable_reason = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN #{reason} ELSE NULL END, disable_time = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, disabled_by = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{doctorId} AND status = '待审核'

UPDATE doctor SET status = #{doctorStatus}, disable_reason = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN #{reason} ELSE NULL END, disable_time = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, disabled_by = CASE WHEN #{doctorStatus} = '停用' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{doctorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'DOCTOR_REVIEW', #{result}, 'DOCTOR', #{doctorId}, LEFT(CONCAT( '医生ID=', #{doctorId}, '，姓名=', #{doctorName}, '，审核=', CASE #{result} WHEN 'PASS' THEN '通过' ELSE '拒绝' END, CASE WHEN #{reason} IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('，原因=', #{reason}) END ), 100), #{reason}, '成功' )

INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'DOCTOR_STATUS', CASE #{action} WHEN '禁用' THEN 'DISABLE' ELSE 'RESTORE' END, 'DOCTOR', #{doctorId}, LEFT(CONCAT( '医生ID=', #{doctorId}, '，姓名=', #{doctorName}, '，操作=', #{action}, CASE WHEN #{reason} IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('，原因=', #{reason}) END ), 100), #{reason}, '成功' )
